theme_central: Two-act structure: a demanding spiritual "training camp" (rising, reciting, enduring) followed by a merciful final relief in the very last verse.
sources_note: 2-act structure precisely sourced (SRA analysis via researchgate.net): 1-19 (demand), 20 (relief, revealed later).

branches.title: Command of the night prayer
branches.resume: Rising at night, reciting the Qur'an slowly; a weighty word is about to be revealed; devoting oneself to Allah.

children.t: Night prayer, slow recitation, exclusive devotion to Allah

branches.title: Patience, warning
branches.resume: Patience toward the disbelievers, withdrawing with dignity; a warning similar to the one sent to Pharaoh.

children.t: Patience and dignity toward the disbelievers, the punishment awaiting them
A warning like the one sent to Pharaoh; this is a Reminder

branches.title: Final relief
branches.resume: Allah knows one cannot keep count of the hours of the night; prayer lightened, priority to zakat and lawful struggle.

children.t: Relief of the night obligation, priority to zakat and effort
